apps.name: HasuAI
apps.desc: Photo studio — one-tap auto enhance, HDR effect, smoothing, filters and sliders. All on-device; photos never leave your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: Warmth slider for Snapseed-style temperature control, plus a Noir high-contrast black-and-white filter. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuBackup
apps.desc: Backup — save any installed app as an APK into Download/HasuBackup, back up everything at once, or share an APK.
apps.changes: NEW: sort the app list by Name, Largest or Newest (by install date), remembered between opens. Rotating the phone no longer wipes your search text or the system-apps toggle. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuBattery
apps.desc: Battery level, live power details, charge history graph and a full-charge alarm.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuBoard
apps.desc: The HasuOS keyboard — liquid glass, skins & fonts, GIFs, clipboard, a private vault and Bangla phonetic typing.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top rows of the app menu, About and Permissions screens could sit too high under the status bar — all screens now start below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuBrowser
apps.desc: Browser — light and fast browsing with bookmarks, history, downloads and desktop mode.
apps.changes: Find in page is now a real find bar: type to highlight matches, see '3 of 12', jump up and down, and close it with Back. Rotating the phone no longer reloads every tab — each tab comes back with its history and scroll position intact. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuCalc
apps.desc: Calculator — fast glass calculator with history plus a unit converter for length, weight, temperature, area, speed and data.
apps.changes: NEW: tap the result to copy it to the clipboard — with a small hint under the display. Rotating the phone no longer drops you back to the Calculator tab when you were converting units. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuCalendar
apps.desc: Calendar — month view with events, times and reminder notifications. Private, no account needed.
apps.changes: NEW: search events by title and jump straight to the day, the way Google Calendar does it. The day header now shows how many events that day has. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuCam
apps.desc: Capture Beyond Limits — pro camera with LMC XML configs, Lib Patcher, AI scene, HDR & Night merge, 20 modes.
apps.changes: Hourly improvement pass (code 93).

apps.name: HasuClean
apps.desc: Storage cleaner — find the largest files, duplicate photos and junk folders, and free space safely.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuClock
apps.desc: Clock — alarms with repeat days and snooze, stopwatch with laps, a timer that rings from the background, and world clocks.
apps.changes: 12-hour time everywhere now — the 24H toggle is gone (standing rule), including the widgets. Fixed: a running timer now survives a reboot and rings; the test alarm no longer kills a running timer; snoozing from the ring screen can no longer wipe the alarm's next ring; two alarms made in the same instant can no longer share an id. NEW: snooze length you choose (5/10/15/20/30 min), 12 more world cities, and the video-alarm preview is a glass dialog.

apps.name: HasuDice
apps.desc: Dice roller and coin flip — roll 1 to 4 dice with a shuffle animation and a running total, flip a coin with heads and tails tallies, and keep your last rolls on screen.
apps.changes: The coin now remembers too — reopen HasuDice and your last flip (heads or tails) is still showing, next to the running tallies.

apps.name: HasuFiles
apps.desc: File manager — browse all storage, categories for images, videos, music, documents & APKs, search, copy/move, zip & extract.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub — drawn toggle at the top of the main screen opens FilesPermsActivity with real live states (All-files access, Install unknown apps) + Turn-all-on walk. FIXED: thumbnail-pool leak on recreate, viewer no longer keeps every photo bitmap in memory, bin index can no longer lose an entry when two deletes race, zip-slip guard hardened, extract closes its streams, Settings sort now offers Type too. NEW: category/search results are re-used when coming back (no more full re-scan), with a Refresh chip to force one.

apps.name: HasuGameBox
apps.desc: Five games in one box — Tic Tac Toe against the computer, classic Snake, Memory Match, 2048 and Tap Rush. Best scores are kept for every game, all offline.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuHabit
apps.desc: Habit tracker — build good habits with streaks, week dots and monthly completion. Tap to mark each day done.
apps.changes: NEW: sort your habits by Newest, Name A–Z or Longest streak from a cycling chip. The week dots are tappable now — tap any dot to mark or unmark that day, so yesterday counts too. The About page has the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuHealth
apps.desc: Health — step counter with 7-day history, daily water tracker with a goal, and a BMI calculator. All on your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: a daily step goal — set it from the Steps card (10,000 by default) and watch your progress live, with a celebration when you reach it. The BMI card now shows the healthy weight range for your height, and the About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuKhata
apps.desc: Daily hisab in taka: month summary, categories and day-by-day entries.
apps.changes: NEW: monthly spending budget — set a limit from the 🎯 Budget pill and watch the live progress bar turn red when you go over. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuLock
apps.desc: App lock — protect any app with a PIN pad and fingerprint unlock.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuMusic
apps.desc: Music player — songs, albums and artists from your library, background playback with notification controls, shuffle and repeat.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub — a 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top of the library opens one screen with every permission and its real live state, plus a ✅ Turn all on walk. Headset buttons and the lock screen now control playback. A file that will not play skips to the next song instead of stopping silently. NEW: ▶ Play all and 🔀 Shuffle all for the whole library (or the open album/artist). The last-crash dialog is now premium glass.

apps.name: HasuNamaz
apps.desc: Prayer times for Bangladesh — offline calculation, next-waqt countdown, Qibla compass and per-waqt alarms.
apps.changes: NEW: the Hijri date now shows under the Gregorian date (offline calculation), like the best prayer apps. Rotating the phone no longer drops you back to the Prayer times tab, the countdown no longer ticks twice, and the About page now carries the website row (hasuos.github.io).

apps.name: HasuNews
apps.desc: Bangla news — Prothom Alo and BBC Bangla headlines, articles open inside the app, and last headlines stay saved for offline reading.
apps.changes: NEW: save any headline with ☆ — your saved stories live under a ★ Saved filter with its count. Rotating the phone in the article reader no longer reloads from the top (scroll position and back history survive), your search text survives rotation too, and the About page now carries the website row (hasuos.github.io).

apps.name: HasuNotes
apps.desc: Notes — quick private notes with pinning, colours and search. Auto-saves, no account, everything stays on your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: sort your notes — Newest, Oldest or Title A–Z — from a chip under the search box, remembered between opens. Rotating the phone no longer loses your search, your place in the list, or the cursor in the editor, and the About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuOS Home
apps.desc: Your home screen, HasuOS style — a liquid-glass launcher with widgets, an App Library, lock screen and themes.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top rows of the settings hub, Permissions and About screens could sit too high under the status bar — all screens now start below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuPDF
apps.desc: PDF tools — photos to PDF, merge PDFs and split out pages, saved to Download/HasuPDF.
apps.changes: NEW: sort your PDFs — Newest, Name A–Z or Largest — from a chip above the list, remembered between opens. Rotating the phone no longer throws away the photos you picked or the PDF you were about to split, and the About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuQuick
apps.desc: A floating assistive ball — favourite apps and quick actions (home, torch, lock, screenshot) anywhere.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top rows of every screen could sit too high under the status bar — all screens now start below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuRadio
apps.desc: Live radio — Radio Foorti, Bangladesh Betar, Jago FM, Peoples Radio, Radio Today and BBC World Service, with favourites and background playback.
apps.changes: NEW: a sleep timer on the player — tap ⏱ to stop the radio by itself after 15, 30 or 60 minutes, with the minutes left showing live. Plus a search box to find a station by name, and the About page now carries the website row (hasuos.github.io).

apps.name: HasuScan
apps.desc: QR & barcode scanner with torch and gallery scan — plus a QR maker for text, links, Wi-Fi and more.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuShare
apps.desc: Offline file sharing — pick files, share them over WiFi or hotspot, and the other phone downloads them from your browser address. No internet needed.
apps.changes: NEW: a live download counter — while sharing, the status line shows how many files the other phone has downloaded. The picked-files list now shows its total size. FIXED: a failed response header used to leak the opened file stream; the stream, headers and body now share one try/finally. The About page has the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuShikha
apps.desc: English words — 120 common words with Bangla meanings and examples. Flip the card, mark what you know, review what you missed.
apps.changes: NEW: a Listen button reads the current word aloud in US English, the way top flashcard apps teach pronunciation — the speech engine starts only on the first tap. The About page has the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuShot
apps.desc: Screenshots & screen recording from a floating button — gallery, crop, edit and recycle bin built in.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top rows of every screen could sit too high under the status bar — all screens now start below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuSpeed
apps.desc: Live internet speed in your notification — download & upload now, today's totals and per-app usage.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top of the screen (the Permissions row) could slide under the status bar and get cut off — every screen now starts below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuStore
apps.desc: Your Play Store — every HasuOS app, in one place. Online updates included.
apps.changes: Crash fix: downloads could kill the store itself (foreground-service start race on Samsung) — the download service now announces itself the instant it is created, so downloads no longer die or take the app down with them. Also includes the 1.96 fixes: real icons for online-only apps like HasuMaps, and the download-time display fix.

apps.name: HasuTasbih
apps.desc: Digital tasbih — a big tap circle for dhikr counting: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar and La ilaha illallah, targets of 33, 99 or 100, rounds and a lifetime total, all remembered.
apps.changes: The screen now stays awake while you count — a long dhikr round no longer goes dark in the middle.

apps.name: HasuTask
apps.desc: To-dos — tasks with a date, time and priority, and reminders that fire on time. Filter by Today, All or Done.
apps.changes: NEW: sort your tasks — Due date, Priority or Title A–Z — from a chip under the filters, remembered between opens. NEW: a Clear done button that wipes all finished tasks in one confirmed go, and the About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuTools
apps.desc: Tools — compass, bubble level, real-size ruler and a torch with strobe and SOS modes.
apps.changes: NEW: a peak dB readout on the Sound meter — the loudest moment of the session, resetting on each visit. Rotating the phone no longer drops back to the Compass tab: the tab you were on is restored. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuUsage
apps.desc: Usage — see where your time goes: screen time and data per app for today, yesterday and the last 7 days.
apps.changes: NEW: every app row now shows how many times you opened it, the way Digital Wellbeing counts launches. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuVault
apps.desc: A private vault for photos, videos & PDFs — AES-256 encryption, PIN and fingerprint lock.
apps.changes: The website link is now on the About page, like every HasuOS app.

apps.name: HasuVoice
apps.desc: Voice recorder — one-tap recording with a live level meter, playback, rename and share.
apps.changes: NEW: the player now has a playback-speed control (0.5x to 2x) and 10-second skip buttons, so you can skim a long recording the way top recorders let you. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuWall
apps.desc: Your gallery — photos & videos with editors, live wallpapers, favourites and a recycle bin.
apps.changes: Fixed: the top rows of every screen could sit too high under the status bar — all screens now start below the real status-bar height.

apps.name: HasuWeather
apps.desc: Weather — current conditions and a 7-day forecast for any city on earth, powered by Open-Meteo.
apps.changes: NEW: a °C / °F toggle in the header — every temperature (now, feels like, hourly, 7-day) converts at once, remembered between opens. Rotating the phone no longer flashes 'Loading…' and re-fetches: a forecast cached in the last 30 minutes shows instantly. The About page now carries the HasuOS website row.

apps.name: HasuOS
apps.desc: Every HasuOS app in one place — the whole family with its details, straight from the live catalogue. Tap any app for its story, version and size, and get it through HasuStore.
apps.changes: NEW APP: the whole HasuOS family in one app — every app with its details, refreshed live from the catalogue.

apps.name: Hasu
apps.desc: Hasu's whole details in one app — a living portfolio: name, role, story, work and contact, all editable on the phone. The developer behind HasuOS.
apps.changes: The contact card is complete — email, Facebook and YouTube are in, and every row now opens its link.

apps.name: HasuTube
apps.desc: YouTube inside its own HasuOS app: home feed, Shorts, subscriptions and library, built-in search and real full-screen video.
apps.changes: NEW app: YouTube inside its own HasuOS glass app — home feed, Shorts, subscriptions and library one tap away, search built in, and real full-screen video.

apps.name: HasuWeb
apps.tag: The HasuOS website, as an app
apps.desc: The HasuOS website inside its own app: the same pages and the same live catalogue, served by the website's own server — every app update shows here the moment it reaches the website.
apps.changes: First release — the HasuOS website as its own app, running on the website's server, always as current as the site itself.

apps.name: HasuMaps
apps.tag: The HasuOS map — the world, in glass
apps.desc: His idea, straight from his message: Google Maps, the HasuOS way. The full OpenStreetMap in one glass window — search any place on Earth, directions for car, bike and foot, and a Locate button that centres the map on you from your phone's GPS. No API key, no Google services: open map data, plus the family Permissions hub and About page.
apps.changes: Navigation is here: tap Start on the route card and HasuMaps follows you — big next-turn banner with a live distance countdown, voice guidance before each turn, automatic re-route if you leave the line, and an arrival announcement. Stage 2 of the perfection plan.
